installs: A vault-template/ directory copied into a vault location: 13 SKILL.md skill directories, 4 agent definitions, 4 rule documents, and 1 output style under vault-template/.claude/, a plugin manifest at vault-template/.claude-plugin/plugin.json declaring commands, agents, skills, hooks, output styles, and rules, and a vault-template/.claude/settings.json carrying 19 permission allow rules and 3 deny rules, 7 environment variables, and three hook configurations (SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, and a PostToolUse matcher on Write and Edit). The vault content is a root CLAUDE.md with a CLAUDE.local.md.template, 4 Goals documents, 3 note Templates, an example daily note, and an example project with its own CLAUDE.md. Claude Code reads the .claude/ tree from the vault root; Obsidian opens the same directory as a vault. github-actions/claude.yml is offered separately for a vault kept on GitHub.
distribution_machinery: scripts/setup.sh and scripts/setup.bat copy vault-template/ into a chosen vault directory, and scripts/customize.sh rewrites the folder names the configuration refers to. The installed vault's own shipped shell files are .claude/hooks/session-init.sh, which exports path and date variables and prints vault status at session start; .claude/hooks/skill-discovery.sh, which prints the pack's own SKILL.md names and descriptions when a prompt mentions skills or help; .claude/hooks/auto-commit.sh, which runs git add and git commit over the vault after the host writes or edits a file, when GIT_AUTO_COMMIT is true; and .claude/scripts/statusline.sh.
not_a_system: Owns no state it reads back through code it ships and does no enforced work: its skills, agents, and rules are Markdown that Claude Code executes with its own tools, two of its hooks only print the pack's own documents and vault status into the session, and the third commits the vault to git after the host has already written, which records what the host did rather than enforcing anything and which ADR 031 holds never qualifies a pack on its own.
